name: Recursive Teaching Dimension of Chen–Cheng–Tang Teaching Products
details: For every integer $n\ge1$; $n$ is the number of twelve-coordinate blocks. The ratio $\mathrm{RTD}/\mathrm{VC}=5/3$ is constant, despite the growing additive gap.
proof: For every finite class, minimum teaching size is at most RTD, which is at most teaching dimension. The minimum-teaching and teaching-dimension values for this product family are both $5n$, giving equality. The construction and ordinary RTD/VC product values are Figure 4 and Section 3 of \cite{chen2016recursive}.
references: \cite{chen2016recursive}, Section 3 and Figure 4; \cite{doliwa2014recursive}, Lemma 16. Definition-driven finite verification: sync/verify_chen_teaching_products.py and sync/chen_teaching_products.json.
